channel.title: RISC-V Distros — Boards
channel.description: From QEMU to classic boards: what each board runs and what its official OS is

item.title: Boards — QEMU virt (virtual machine)
item.description: Pure virtual platform: up to 512 RV64GC cores, CLINT/PLIC, a PCIe host bridge, 8 virtio-mmio devices, NS16550 UART, optional AIA/IOMMU; memory, disks and networking are all virtualised through command-line options, with no real GPU/VPU/NPU.
item.category: None (generic QEMU virtual platform, RV32/RV64 configurable, up to 512 cores)

item.title: Boards — StarFive VisionFive 2
item.description: 2/4/8GB LPDDR4, microSD + eMMC (some versions), M.2 M-Key NVMe, 2× GbE (v1.3 supports PoE), HDMI 2.0, 4× USB, 40-pin GPIO; there is also a cut-down VisionFive 2 Lite.
item.category: StarFive JH7110: 4×SiFive U74 @1.5GHz + S7 monitor core + E24

item.title: Boards — LicheePi 4A
item.description: 4/8/16GB LPDDR4X, 8/32/128GB eMMC, 2× GbE, WiFi5/BT5, HDMI 2.0 + 4-lane MIPI DSI, 2× MIPI CSI, 4× USB3, 40-pin GPIO.

item.title: Boards — Milk-V Meles
item.description: 4/8/16GB LPDDR4X 4266MT/s, eMMC socket (optional module) + microSD, 1× GbE (PoE capable), WiFi5/BT5.2 (AP6256), 4× USB3.0, HDMI 2.0 4K60, MIPI DSI/CSI, 40-pin, credit-card sized.

item.title: Boards — SpacemiT K3 (Pico-ITX / CoM260)
item.description: 8× X100 @2.4GHz + 8× A100 AI cores, RVA23/RVV1.0 (up to 1024-bit), 60 TOPS general AI compute, 130 KDMIPS. Pico-ITX: 16/32GB LPDDR5-6400, UFS2.2 128/256GB, 10GbE SFP+ + 1GbE, 2× M.2 (M-Key Gen3 x4 / B-Key), 2× USB3.2 Type-C (full-featured 65W PD + 4K DP) + 4× USB2.0, 100×86mm. CoM260: a 260-pin compute module plus a reference carrier board, the carrier being hardware-compatible with Jetson Orin Nano.

item.title: Boards — Zhihe A210 (XuanTie MelonPi dev board)
item.description: 8-core 64-bit RISC-V: 4× C920 @1.9GHz + 4× C908 @1.9GHz, all with RVV (128-bit); NPU 12 TOPS@INT8 supporting INT4/INT8/FP8/FP16/BF16 and Transformers; LPDDR4X up to 16GB; eMMC5.1; H.265 decode 4K@120fps; the board is a SODIMM compute module plus V1/V2/V3 open carrier boards, 8GB LPDDR4X + 32GB eMMC (figures from a third-party project page)

item.title: Boards — Canaan K230 (Kendryte K230 / CanMV-K230)
item.description: Dual-core 64-bit RISC-V C908: big core 1.6GHz with RVV1.0, little core 0.8GHz; KPU rated at 6 TOPS equivalent (INT8/INT16) (1 TOPS on the K230D); the CanMV-K230 board carries 512MB LPDDR4, microSD, HDMI, 3× MIPI-CSI and USB; typical chip power is about 2W

item.title: Boards — Milk-V Megrez (ESWIN EIC7700X)
item.description: 4× SiFive P550 @1.8GHz (RV64GBCH, ships at 1.4GHz/800mV); 19.95 TOPS@INT8 NPU; IMG AXM-8-256 GPU (OpenGL ES3.2/Vulkan1.2/OpenCL); 8/16/32GB LPDDR5-6400; Mini-ITX 170×170mm; PCIe x8 slot (Gen3 x4), 2× GbE, 4× USB3, SATA/M.2 SATA, 8K H.265 encode/decode

item.title: Boards — Milk-V Titan (UltraRISC DP1000)
item.description: 8× UR-CP100 @2.0GHz, RV64GCBHX (full RVA22, no V extension); up to 64GB DDR4 UDIMM (ECC supported); PCIe Gen4 x16, NVMe Gen4 x4, 2× GbE, USB3; Mini-ITX; UEFI+ACPI+SMBIOS; optional BMC module; no onboard display output

item.title: Boards — SiFive HiFive Unmatched
item.description: 16GB DDR4 onboard, PCIe x16 (for a GPU/NVMe), M.2 Key M, M.2 Key E (WiFi), GbE, 4× USB 3.0, microSD, SPI Flash; microATX form factor with 12V barrel power.

item.title: Boards — Banana Pi BPI-F3 (SpacemiT K1)
item.description: 8× X60 (RV64GCVB, RVA22, RVV1.0), 2.0 TOPS; IMG BXE-2-32 GPU @819MHz; 2/4/8/16GB LPDDR4; 8/16/32/128GB eMMC; 2× GbE, 4× USB3.0, HDMI1.4 (1080p), PCIe2.1 (M.2 M-Key + mini PCIe), WiFi6/BT5.2; 148×100mm

item.title: Boards — Orange Pi RV2 (Ky X1)
item.description: 8-core 64-bit RISC-V (single-core performance about 1.3× a Cortex-A55), 2 TOPS fused CPU compute (no dedicated NPU); 2/4/8GB LPDDR4X; optional 16–128GB eMMC module; 2× M.2 M-Key (PCIe2.0 x2, NVMe capable), 2× GbE, WiFi5/BT5, 3× USB3 + 2× USB2, HDMI, 89×56mm

item.title: Boards — SiFive HiFive Premier P550
item.description: 4× SiFive P550 @1.4GHz (out-of-order); 16/32GB LPDDR5-6400 + 128GB eMMC; 20 TOPS NPU; Imagination GPU; Mini-DTX; PCIe Gen3 x4 (x16 slot), 2× GbE, 5× USB3, SATA; Ubuntu 24.04 preinstalled (6.6 kernel, OTA supported)

item.title: Boards — StarFive VisionFive 2 Lite (JH7110S)
item.description: 4× RV64GC @1.25GHz + IMG BXE-4-32 MC1 GPU; 2/4/8GB LPDDR4; WiFi6/BT5.4; M.2 (PCIe2.0 x1), GbE, USB2.0/3.0, HDMI 4K@60, 40-pin GPIO, MIPI-CSI/DSI; microSD/eMMC

item.title: Boards — BeagleV-Ahead
item.description: 4GB LPDDR4, 16GB onboard eMMC, WiFi5/BT5 (AP6203BM), GbE, microHDMI, microSD, 2× CSI + 1× DSI, mikroBUS, BeagleBone Black cape headers.

item.title: Boards — Milk-V Pioneer (SG2042, server-oriented)
item.description: 4× DDR4 DIMM up to 128GB (ECC RDIMM/UDIMM), 3× PCIe x16 (Gen3 x8 signalling), 5× SATA, 2× 2.5GbE, 8× USB3, 2× M.2, an eMMC module connector, microSD; mATX 24.4×24.4cm with standard 24-pin ATX power, 120W typical.

item.title: Boards — Milk-V Duo series (Duo / Duo 256M / Duo S)
item.description: Duo: 2× C906 (1GHz + 700MHz) + an 8051, 64MB SIP DRAM; Duo 256M: SG2002 plus 1× Cortex-A53, 256MB; Duo S: 512MB + eMMC pads (some kits ship 8GB) + WiFi6; all have a 100M Ethernet port and USB-C; Duo/256M are 26-pin GPIO pads at 21×51mm, Duo S has 2× 26-pin headers at 43×43mm.
